scope: Static inventory, not a new emission, installed-byte measurement or per-call experiment. PLT32 relocations in 239 retained 2026-11-16 extracted entry proofs identify possible read leaves under the current selection. Numeric transfers and future loaded programs are not inferred. Fixed count/domain meets are deliberately not guessed. All counted leaves treated as generic gives an upper bound; current constant tails, branch-width changes and layout/metadata cost can lower it. Historical payload totals are context only and are not current image installed totals.
